title: Former Jaguars LB Devin Lloyd signs with Panthers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former Jaguars LB Devin Lloyd signs with Panthers
sources.description: Devin Lloyd didn't wait long to find his next home, agreeing to terms with Carolina on the opening day of the legal tampering period. With a hole now at the heart of Anthony Campanile's defense, where do the Jaguars go from here?
